name: Chaemin Jang
title: M.S. Student, KAIST School of Computing
lead: I study the gap between what language models learn and what they can actually use.
bio: I’m an M.S. student at KAIST, co-advised by Jihee Kim and Dongman Lee.
home_description: Chaemin Jang is a researcher at KAIST studying what language models learn, remember, and produce. Publications, preprints, and CV.
og_description: Research on knowledge, retrieval, and behavior in language models.
split: My papers keep finding the same split. A model knows something, whether a fact, a formula, a distribution, or its own judgment, and yet does not act on it. I study where that gap comes from, how to measure it, and when it can be closed.
